notes: ACCESS: direct fetch, HTTP 200 throughout, no WAF (same as the prior Home-Decor pass). Shopify store. NAV: the mega-menu is a Vue component (#vue-desktop-nav) with no server-rendered links. Recovered the tree two ways and cross-checked them: (a) the site's headless CMS - GET https://cdn.builder.io/api/v3/content/nav?apiKey=ffd771d56cde49a3932ba2dc845afab8 returns 10 published nav variants; the newest, 'Default Nav 2026' (lastUpdated 2026-08-13), is the live one; (b) rendered the live homepage in Chrome and read the hydrated #vue-desktop-nav anchors - the Furniture menu matched 'Default Nav 2026' item-for-item, so the tree below is the site's current live navigation. The Furniture department has exactly two published branches, 'Shop by Room' (Bedroom / Living Room / Bath / Outdoor) and 'Shop by Category' (Beds & Headboards / Ottomans & Benches / Chairs & Sofas / Tables & Nightstands / Dressers / Accent Furniture / Outdoor Furniture), plus 'Swatches'. Neither branch is a parent of the other - they are two parallel cuts of the same 49-product furniture catalogue, so BOTH are emitted and BOTH grouping rows carry an overlap flag. Do not sum them: shop-all-furniture (the department total, not emitted as a leaf under rule 3) is 49 products, while the room rows sum to 104 and the category rows to 73. QTY METHOD - THE RENDERED HEADER ON THIS SITE IS NOT A PRODUCT COUNT AND WAS REJECTED WITH PROOF. The PLP ('ComboPLP' template) prints 'N Products' where N is the number of merchandised TILES, which includes (i) one product split into several colour/size tiles and (ii) injected promo banner tiles. Proof: /collections/dressers renders 'ORDER 3 Products' but all three tiles link to the single product /products/avon-dresser (Natural Ash / Natural Walnut / Black Finished Ash); /collections/all-seating-chairs prints '12 Products' but one of the 12 grid <li> elements is a 'Throw Pillows - Shop by Size' banner with no product link; /collections/beds prints '21 Products' with an 'Order Swatches' banner tile among them; /collections/bedroom-furniture prints '42 Products' but has only 41 distinct product URLs (Avon Nightstand is tiled twice, Standard and Wide); /collections/shop-all-furniture prints '96 Products' against a 49-product collection. QTY USED = the site's own analytics blob on each collection page ('collection_handle':'<handle>','total_products':<n>, HTML-entity-escaped in the ShopifyAnalytics script), independently confirmed by exhaustive enumeration of /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250&page=N to an empty page counting UNIQUE product ids. The two methods agreed on 12/12 furniture handles with zero divergence (49/41/42/8/13/16/19/11/23/1/3/2), reproducing the prior pass's 16/16 agreement on this site. Third corroboration: the site's Searchspring index (siteId g4yph2, pagination.totalResults, discrimination-checked - a bogus handle returns 0) agreed on 12 of 14 handles, differing only on 'beds' (15 vs 16), so it was used as a cross-check only, never as the source. No Shopify /collections.json products_count was used (known-inflated). No tile-href counting was used. EXCLUDED FROM THE NAV: 'Shop All' (x2), 'Ready to Ship Furniture' (in-stock-collection-furniture, 15 - an availability cut of nodes already counted) and 'Custom Furniture' (custom-furniture, 24 - a made-to-order fulfilment cut of nodes already counted) under rule 3; the whole 'Swatches' sub-menu (all-swatches / swatches-mto-seating / swatches-mto-beds) as fabric samples, i.e. furniture parts. 'Outdoor Furniture' appears twice in the Furniture menu, under Shop by Room as 'Outdoor' and again under Shop by Category, at the identical URL - emitted ONCE, under Shop by Room. 'Bath Furniture' in the top-level Bath menu is the same URL as Furniture > Shop by Room > Bath - emitted once. ORPHANS CHECKED AND REJECTED: the 1,145-entry collections sitemap contains deeper room x type handles (bedroom-furniture-beds-headboards 16, bedroom-furniture-nightstands 12, bedroom-furniture-ottomans-benches 17, bedroom-furniture-chairs 0, living-room-furniture-chairs-sofas 6, living-room-furniture-coffee-side-tables 5, living-room-furniture-ottomans 13, living-room-furniture-benches 5) plus headboards 2, upholstered-beds 9, seating 5, all-bedroom-furniture, entryway. None of these appears in ANY of the 10 Builder nav variants, none is linked from the room PLPs (checked the rendered DOM and the raw HTML - the room pages carry no sub-category chips), one of them is empty, and their children do not reconcile with their parent (16+0+12+17=45 vs bedroom-furniture 41). They are dead PLP-redesign artifacts, not a live level of the taxonomy, so no deeper level was recorded. 'kitchen-furniture' (2: Meru Counter Stool - Mindi, Meru Counter Stool - Teak) is a real furniture collection that appears in the nine OLDER nav variants but has been dropped from the live 'Default Nav 2026'; it was therefore not emitted, and nothing is lost because both stools are already inside Chairs & Sofas. NOT FURNITURE, so no other department was mined: Rugs, Bedding, Pillows & Throws, Decor (baskets/wall hangings/framed art/planters/vases/accents/tabletop), Bath towels-mats-accessories, Archive Sale, and all New Arrivals / Best Sellers / Ready to Ship / Back in Stock / seasonal-event nodes.
